context_requirements: Functional TRPV1 expression and signaling; most immortalized lines in this panel have low or absent TRPV1
Neuronal or sensory lineage for canonical TRPV1-dependent transcriptional output
Presence of TRPV1 agonists or inflammatory mediators that activate the channel
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h across multiple cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across TRPV antagonists that is absent for inactive analogs
Enrichment of TRPV1-dependent genes or calcium-regulated immediate early genes after treatment

evidence.supports: TRPV antagonist ruthenium red blocks TRPV4-dependent SOX9 reporter activity, showing TRPV antagonism can modulate transcription in a context-dependent manner
